description: Submit a recreated video as an official HyperCodeMotion Studio gallery template, with the moderator code: the source link, its three compositions (cuadrado 1080×1080, vertical 1080×1920, horizontal 1920×1080) and the gallery card. It checks the source, the compositions and the card; if anything fails it returns accepted: false with the errors to fix and stores nothing. When accepted, the composition in the original's format is rendered with the Studio engine and compared with the original frame by frame; get_proposal_status returns that comparison. To send fixes after a comparison, call it again with the same code (up to 3 comparisons): send only patch (the changes, applied to the stored compositions; card may be left out) instead of the three full compositions, unless you are redesigning. Nothing is published until publish_template. A video that is already a template is not stored twice.

adminCode.description: The moderator code the user gave with the link. Required: only moderators can make gallery templates. Never repeat it back.

card.description: Gallery card, in Spanish. Required on a first proposal; a revision keeps the previous one when left out.

code.description: Only to send a revision after a comparison: the tracking code of the first proposal.

compositions.description: The three compositions, as objects or JSON-encoded strings. Required on a first proposal; a revision may send patch instead.

patch.description: Only with code, instead of compositions: the changes to the stored compositions. Each item {op: replace|add|remove|edit, path: JSON pointer such as /layers/3/props/fontSize or /docs/s1, value (replace, add), find and replace (edit: changes one exact piece of a text such as a doc's HTML or CSS; find must appear once), variants: which of cuadrado, vertical, horizontal (default all three)}.

url.description: Link of the source video's page, the same one given to get_recreation_brief.

name: propose_template
title: Propose a gallery template
